tandemFrageBeispiel.frage: What do you enjoy doing at weekends?
tandemFrageBeispiel.antwort: I enjoy walking in the park.

tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B takes the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “What do you enjoy doing after work?” (Add do and -ing.)

B hears the question and builds the answer. Think about the verb pattern: after enjoy, stop, avoid and love use -ing; after want, hope, need and decide use to + verb. Change the blue verb if you need to.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Last, swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p2: After enjoy, stop and avoid use -ing. After want, hope and decide use to.

tandemRedemittel.p1: Sorry? Can you say that again, please?
